features.title: Browse and edit workspace files
features.summary: Browse bounded project files, open session-scoped Monaco tabs, search and go to line, preserve dirty drafts, and save through Host file APIs.

configuration.constraints: One of workbench or right-panel; applies live.

failureModes: A stale file hash raises a conflict and requires reload or explicit overwrite.
Traversal, symlink, protected metadata, missing parent, and oversized writes are rejected.

externalDependencies.boundary: Host project file list/read/write API over a registered local workspace.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Use temporary directories with synthetic files and edits; do not read or write a user repository.

features.title: Index workspace files with bounded traversal
features.summary: Traverse breadth-first with concurrency and entry limits, skipping VCS and dependency directories while surfacing partial results.
failureModes: Unreadable directories are skipped with partial results.
A stale index is refreshed before searching.
